RTL, the full catalog and a single-source registry

Highlights:
- RTL support across every component and block, with a preview toggle
- 15 new components bringing the catalog to ~45: pickers, color picker, signature pad, image cropper and compare, lightbox, QR code, calendar heatmap, audio player, masonry, tour and more
- New blocks: dashboard, e-commerce and FAQ layouts
- Global error and 404 pages
- registry-meta.ts is now the single source of truth, with a CI drift check

Fixes:
- inline-edit and currency-input typing bugs
- Removed em dashes across the site
- Switched the social link to GitHub
